decisions.reason: The air quality sensor module is a featured, distinctive part of the modular building-block system, and firms of this type keep such modules on sale for many years.
It is the current version that replaced the 2.0 module, so it is the live generation of a basic, steadily demanded measurement function.
CAN bus interfacing is a lasting industrial need, and the module fits the established modular ecosystem at low upkeep cost.
CO2 sensing demand stays strong, though there is some risk that a newer hardware revision replaces this version as happens across the product line.
